name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand or both hands in front of your thighs, shifting your weight onto one slightly bent standing leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending your free leg straight behind you, lowering the weight close to your standing shin.
Stop when your torso is nearly parallel to the floor or you feel a firm stretch in your standing hamstring with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glute to return upright, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor rather than opening the lifted hip outward.
Maintain a neutral spine and let the weight hang straight down close to your leg.
